# Voice providers
Source: https://docs.genguardx.ai/integrations/voice-providers/
Markdown: https://docs.genguardx.ai/integrations/voice-providers/index.md
Description: Connect voice AI providers such as Deepgram to GGX with an API key.

Voice providers supply speech-to-text, text-to-speech, and voice agent capabilities. Connect one in **Org Settings → Integrations → Voice providers**.

| Integration | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [Deepgram](https://docs.genguardx.ai/integrations/voice-providers/deepgram/) | Speech-to-text, text-to-speech, and voice agents. |
